kind_of_no: private park with no price indicator and no live presence: dormant Hipcamp listing, no website, Google under 25 reviews
why: Google Maps 'Jacobs Landing Campground' (6437 Evergreen Acres Dr, Wentworth SD 57075; 4.7/16, phone 605-360-9618, no website; gm.py read 2026-11-22) has under 25 reviews, so it cannot stand in for a website. Its only other presence, Hipcamp land nelh9lxr (hipcamp.com/en-US/land/south-dakota-jacobs-landing-campground-nelh9lxr, Next.js data read 2026-11-22), is an external listing created 2025-06-24 with status ASLEEP, isBookable false, isPaused true, 0 sites, no price and 0 bookings; its own text says only 'The campground features full hookups on-site'. The booking URL that listing names (refined-travel.com/parks/jacobs-landing-campground) is a parked domain that redirects to '/lander'. Not in RV Life's index (Algolia query 'Jacobs Landing' and bbox 43.88..44.05 N, -97.10..-96.90 return only Walker's Point, 2026-11-22), not in the Good Sam directory cache, and web searches found no own website, Facebook page, Campspot/RoverPass listing or posted rate. Fails both private indicators (price and presence).
name: Jacobs Landing Campground
flags: Not a duplicate, but it sits right beside 5736 Walker's Point Recreation Area. Google's point 43.9531662,-97.0269829 is about 60 m from 5736's stored pin. Esri World Imagery crop (sat.py, 900 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-22) shows the GFP loops wooded along the Lake Madison shore NORTH of the east-west road, while Jacobs Landing is a separate block SOUTH of that road: about 40 RVs packed in tight parallel rows beside rows of storage garages, behind a band of lake houses. Hipcamp's coordinate (43.9532,-97.027) matches. Side note: 5736's stored pin may sit at the road or entrance south of its loops. Not checked here.

The layout looks like a seasonal or storage-lot park, like Dirks (lead 25) and Basler (lead 26), but with no rate or booking page the nightly share could not be measured. Waterfront was not audited because it is a skip; the RV rows are roughly 250 m from the water, with lake houses between.
If AWH wants it reconsidered, the only route is a phone call to 605-360-9618 to ask whether nightly RV sites are sold to the public and at what rate. Not attempted (no calls).
